alignment: raw same-index samples, starting at the first process call
metadata: exact maps, Learn state/completion frame, output widths and zero/nonzero gate/pulse edges

cases.startup_defaults: No events; constructor defaults and every output remain silent without reading uninitialized source velocities.
cases.all_cells_all_wire_channels: Every default cell and every wire lane, endpoint velocities, independent releases and retriggers.
cases.all_128_notes_mapping_windows: Eight sixteen-note banks cover all ordinary MIDI notes, all sixteen cells and all wire channels.
cases.minimum_pulse_velocity_endpoints: Same-sample on/off and velocities 1 and 127 at all rates; every raw pulse edge is checked.
cases.short_and_long_notes: Immediate, one-sample, short and long held notes retain the minimum pulse and source timer arithmetic.
cases.repeated_note_timer_velocity: Repeated positive NoteOn restarts the cell timer and replaces velocity; one release clears a shared gate.
cases.zero_velocity_note_on_release: Zero-velocity NoteOn releases without restarting its timer or producing a new event.
cases.same_sample_event_order: Ordered on/off/on, on/zero/off and off/on/off groups in the genuine SDK queue.
cases.mono_channel_overlap_release: All accepted channels merge into lane zero with last-event release semantics rather than note ownership.
cases.channel_filter_and_unrelated_messages: Human channel selection walks all sixteen channels; rejected notes and CC messages cannot alter gates.
cases.mpe_hidden_lane_timer_freeze: An unheld lane-16 minimum pulse freezes while mono is active and resumes at its exact remaining timer.
cases.velocity_mode_toggle_held_cells: Mode changes preserve held cells and stored velocities while changing output amplitude.
cases.unmapped_held_cell_remap: A held cell remains active through unmapping and remapping; the old note-off no longer finds it.
cases.collision_arrays_keep_cell_signal: Actual JSON array loader normalizes collisions last-cell-wins while displaced active cells retain signals.
cases.learn_positive_repeated_collision: Rejected channels, offs, zero velocity and CC do not Learn; a repeated positive note completes before matching.
cases.learn_same_sample_first_message: First accepted positive NoteOn wins among multiple ordered messages on the same sample.
cases.source_panic_preserves_learn: The genuine source panic primitive clears gates/timers and retains an armed Learn request.
cases.json_mapping_options_snapshot_restore: Actual JSON snapshot and restore change mappings plus velocity/MPE options while preserving cell signal state.
cases.parameter_adoption_preserves_cells: Mapping, channel, velocity and MPE edits exercise Rust rebuild/adoption against source public configuration.
cases.unmapped_notes_ignored: All 128 notes are received across sixteen wire lanes while every assignment is unmapped.
cases.source_panic_with_held_notes: Source panic clears held gates and minimum pulses, followed by new positive notes and releases.
